Module 08: Digital Critical Apparatus — Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Differentiate conceptually between a positive apparatus (which explicitly enumerates witnesses supporting the lemma) and a negative apparatus (which lists only dissenting witnesses).
  • Encode complex multi-witness textual variations using TEI P5 <app>, <lem>, and <rdg> elements with standard @wit pointers.
  • Transform automated CollateX alignment data into well-formed TEI parallel segmentation XML structures.
  • Validate and visualize critical editions using the TEI Critical Apparatus Toolbox and schema linters.
  • Detect and correct common AI apparatus hallucinations, including non-existent manuscript sigla and corrupted lemma boundary tags.
